scope: Proposition 3.3 of the manuscript “Minimal metrics and interior injectivity for nef adjoints” (preprints/Minimal-metrics-and-interior-injectivity-for-nef-adjoints-September-27-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 034 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 b2a7d738f44a3d34), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 14. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let F be a fixed holomorphic line bundle on V , and let hk be smooth metric weights on F|U . Suppose that, for a fixed constant A0 ≥ 0, i∂ ¯ ∂hk ≥ −A0ωc, and that in local frames on V the weights are uniformly bounded above and the functions e−hk have uniformly bounded local integrals on punctured coordinate neighborhoods. Then: (i) There is a continuous linear map κk : Z1 hk −→ H1 (V, KV ⊗ F) agreeing with the ordinary Dolbeault class on smooth closed forms on V . It annihilates the closure in L2 hk (n, 1) of the image of ¯ ∂ : L2 hk (n, 0) → L2 hk (n, 1). (ii) There is a constant C independent of k such that every f ∈ Z1 hk with κk(f) = 0 has a global primitive on U satisfying ¯ ∂v = f, ∥v∥hk ≤ C∥f∥hk . No continuous linear choice of these global primitives is asserted.
